technical-summary: Added a fresh host-pool admission preflight for cache-miss measuring starts. Checked pool per TP rank, KV and reserve against current MemAvailable, cgroup and pin room before power admission or any process start. Added a TP3 session regression proving one-rank headroom is insufficient; retained zero as an explicit disabled-pool value.
user-summary-candidate: Fixed an early-start memory-admission gap: a measuring run now reserves the host pool for every engine rank using freshly detected host room before it can change power settings or start a child.
